entry.content:
Ford's Custom Garage ORV package turns a four-door Bronco into a more capable trail rig, installed by a Ford dealer as a single package so there is no parts list to piece together. A Fox off-road suspension kit adds ground clearance and improves articulation, which helps the Bronco clear obstacles and keep its tires on the ground over uneven terrain, while skid and fuel tank plates borrowed from the Bronco Raptor shield the underbody. Trail armor guards the rocker panels, RIGID auxiliary lights illuminate the trail after dark, and black 17-inch Weld wheels and wider Havoc fender flares give the exterior a broader, darker stance. Ford offers the package as a limited edition on Base, Big Bend, and Outer Banks trims.

Built for tough workouts in even tougher conditions, Timex's Ironman Adrenaline pairs analog hands with a digital display in a 46.5mm matte tan resin case. A stopwatch records up to 50 laps for tracking your training, and a long hold on the 4 o'clock pusher switches the display off when you want a purely analog watch. entry.content:
Arbor makes physician-prescribed GLP-1 weight loss treatment more accessible with transparent pricing that stays put, even as doses change. Plans start at $99/month for compounded semaglutide and $149/month for compounded tirzepatide, with no insurance, hidden fees, or membership costs required. The telehealth platform connects patients with licensed U.S. clinicians through a simple online assessment, with eligible prescriptions shipped free and each subscription covering medication, consultations, dose adjustments, and ongoing support. Board-certified physicians, dietitian-led nutrition guidance, and a 12-month money-back guarantee for eligible members round out a program designed to make medically supervised weight management simpler and more affordable.

entry.summary: Pioneer's TS-X40SXT is an all-new pair of box speakers that take their cues from the company's 1984 TS-X60. A dark silver paint job echoes the original's metallic look, while clear parts and wire mesh grilles carry the period styling over a resin enclosure. The boxes mount to a r
entry.content:
Pioneer's TS-X40SXT is an all-new pair of box speakers that take their cues from the company's 1984 TS-X60. A dark silver paint job echoes the original's metallic look, while clear parts and wire mesh grilles carry the period styling over a resin enclosure. The boxes mount to a rear deck with the included brackets, so nothing has to be cut from door panels or trim. Each one houses a 5-1/4-inch woofer, a 2-1/4-inch midrange and a tweeter, with cellulose fiber cones on the woofer and midrange and double-slit ports to vent the bass. Rated at 100 watts peak, the pair works with any 4-ohm head unit or amp, and Pioneer recommends its matching SXT-C10PS Heritage receiver.

entry.content:
A Bugatti customer with a taste for rare, personalized cars commissioned this one-off Veyron Grand Sport Vitesse, chassis 8.100, with an exposed polished aluminum body that called for blocks of up to 20 tons, sent to Bugatti's atelier in Molsheim, France. The cabin is trimmed in Carmine Red leather, with exposed carbon fiber and handcrafted details. Over a decade on, the car went back to Molsheim, where Bugatti's La Maison Pur Sang heritage program certified and restored it. The car is powered by the Veyron's 8.0-liter quad-turbocharged W16, which makes 1,184 horsepower, and it now belongs to a new owner on the French Riviera.

entry.content:
Leica and Formula 1 launch their partnership with a Leica Q3 43 dressed for the paddock. A new Formula 1 look, available only in the Leica FOTOS app on this camera, adds higher contrast and richer saturation as you shoot, previewed in the viewfinder. The wireless-charging handgrip has a genuine carbon fiber shell, a material Leica doesn't traditionally use, made and tested only in Germany, and the soft-release button has a carbon inlay with a red rim. The non-slip black Microvelour covering is textured like a racing steering wheel, and the red accents echo its color-coded controls. A rope strap bearing both brands' logos and a Formula 1 carrying strap are included.
